en: So you finally decided to raise your head.
What?

Up till yesterday, you were always walking
around staring at your feet, right?

Even when you had to look up, you used your hat 
to block out what you didn't want to see...
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't deny that...

This world can be too big and bright for eyes 
that have spent too long staring down.

So be careful. Don't let your eyes 
deceive you...

Yeah...you're right.
Thanks.
Hmph...sorry for the unsolicited advice.

What's wrong? Your job right now is 
to find out what that junk is for, right?

You're way too busy to waste time 
talking to me.

I thought that statue was strange...
But who coulda guessed it'd do that?

Shuichi, there anything Gonta can do?
Please say so!

Oh, I knew you'd come to check this area.
That dragon statue seems pretty sketchy.

What, I wonder, does Monokuma wish 
for us to do...?
What do you mean?

I cannot fathom the reason he would give us 
those items and make us search the school...

Hm, now that I think of it, the school 
regulations did mention searching the school.

"With minimal restrictions, you are free to 
explore the campus at your discretion"...

This rule is indirectly urging us 
to search the school.
<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, I suppose that is true...

What will come of our search...?
And how will everyone react to it?

I shall closely observe each of them
as well... Kehehe...

What will come of our search...?
And how will everyone react to it?

I shall closely observe each of them
as well... Kehehe...

Oh? It was a hidden passage...?
My, how elaborate.
Have you recovered from your injury?
Injury...?
When Kaito struck you last night.

Ah, yeah, I'm fine.
It didn't bruise or anything, see?

Good. Should it begin to hurt again, please let
me know.

Though I cannot perform surgeries, I can make
use of the medical supplies in the warehouse.
You have medical experience, too, Kirumi?

A true maid must be able to adapt to any
situation. Besides...

I, too, intend to fulfill Kaede's request. So I will
valiantly perform any task, trivial or otherwise.
Kirumi...

<CLT=cltMIND>It sounds like everyone has taken
Kaede's final wish to heart.

<CLT=cltMIND>Even if Kaede is no longer with us...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaede's wish<CLT=cltMIND> will never vanish!

I, too, intend to fulfill Kaede's request. So I will
valiantly perform any task, trivial or otherwise.

I feel stagnant air drifting from this damaged
wall...

As if no one has set foot beyond this point
for quite some time...
...You look better now.

I didn't think you'd get over Kaede's death
so quickly.
...We don't have time to be standing around.

...How heartless. Guess you two weren't as
close as you looked.

That's not true, it's because of the wish Kaede
gave me that I have to keep moving...
<CLT=cltMIND>I made a promise...that I won't give up.

...Do you have time to stop? Hurry up and find
a use for all that junk.

O Atua, who art in heaven...
Please allow Rantaro into thy kingdom...
Ah, sorry, you were praying...

Cuz everyone's so sad over Kaede, they've
forgotten about Rantaro.
So I'm gonna keep praying for him.
N-No, it's not that we forgot!

It's okay. It's easier for me to earn points
if I pray.
It's a shortcut to a platinum membership!
<CLT=cltMIND>Her religion...has a point system?

O Atua, who art in heaven...
Please allow Rantaro into thy kingdom...

Shuichi, we've been waiting for you!
Hurry, hurry! We're all ready!
<CLT=cltMIND>Hurry? Hurry for what?

Go on, try to solve the puzzle! You're
clearly a pro at playing with yourself!

Did you bust your boy-cherry, virgin!?
How's it feel to walk right now!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I could have heard Kaede
play the piano in this classroom...

<CLT=cltMIND>From the look of this door...
This must be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
Alright, let's go inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>Now this is a strange door...
This might be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.

Based on the design, could it be the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Entomologist's Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

<CLT=cltMIND>Stairs... It looks like I can
go to the 3rd floor from here.
They're a little scary...but I'll try it.
Part of the wall is gone!

Whoa, that's so cool! We can get past this wall
now! Alright then, chaaaaarge!
W-Wait! Charging in is dangerous!
...Kirumi, what's wrong?

Nothing, but I feel stagnant air drifting from
this damaged wall...

As if no one has set foot beyond this point
for quite some time...
Nobody's been here for a long time?

<CLT=cltMIND>Exactly how long is a
<CLT=cltSTRONG>long time<CLT=cltMIND>?
<CLT=cltMIND>What is this...? A treasure chest?

Yahoo! We've found a treasure chest!
Why don't you open it, Shuichi?
...Really? I should open it?

I believe this treasure chest is saying you
should open it, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm getting the sense that she thinks
it's dangerous and wants *me* to open it.
...Alright, fine.

<CLT=cltMIND>With sweaty palms, I cautiously
opened the chest, and...

What is this...? A flashlight?
No, it can't be just a flashlight...
Maybe try turning it on?

No, that's too dangerous.
We should inspect it—

Hm? It'll be okay. Even the flashlight is
saying, "Turn me on!"

"Turn me on!" "Hurry up and turn me on,
Shuichi!" It's begging you.

Ah, i-if you're so eager,
why don't *you* flip the switch, Angie?

Then I'll meet you halfway and inspect this
flashlight myself.

*That's* meeting me halfway?
And how are you going to inspect it?

You're right. At times like this, we just
gotta go for it!
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie snatched the flashlight from me.

Let's meet at the gym, Shuichi! I'll go get
the others, you just hurry over!

What?
Why are we meeting in the gym?

You'll get it once you arrive!
Bye-onara!
...And there she goes...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know what she's planning...
but I might as well do as she says.
Meeting me halfway, huh?

Once you understand, I'll come teach you!
Bye-onara!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie snatched the flashlight from me
and ran off with a bounce in her step.
Wait, inspect it? How!?

<CLT=cltMIND>The treasure chest is empty.
That flashlight was the only thing inside.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.
